passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David praised God in this song.
This psalm is a song to God.

passages.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
The LORD is my shepherd.
He cares for me.
I lack nothing.
passages.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃

passages.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
passages.sermon: The LORD is my shepherd.\r\nHe makes me lie down in green pastures.\r\nHe leads me beside quiet waters.
passages.original: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־ מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my shepherd.
He restores my soul.
He guides me in paths of righteousness.
He does this for the sake of His name.
passages.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־ צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks about God as his shepherd.
Sometimes I walk through a very dark valley.
This valley is called the valley of the shadow of death.
I do not fear any evil there.
I do not feel afraid because You are with me.
You have a rod.
You have a staff.
Your rod and Your staff comfort me.
passages.original: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־ אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־ אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־ אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃

passages.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my shepherd.
The LORD prepares a table for me.
He does this while my enemies watch.
The LORD anoints my head with oil.
My cup overflows.
passages.original: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י׀ שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃

passages.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks about his life.
God shows goodness to David.
God shows mercy to David.
Goodness and mercy will follow David every day.
This will happen all his life.
David will live in the house of the LORD.
He will stay there forever.
passages.original: אַ֤ךְ׀ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
